words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.ex: Take my brother as an example, he studies every day.
words.ex_cn: 以我哥哥为例，他每天都学习。
words.en: To use someone or something as an illustration or instance.

words.w: a great example of this is
words.tr: 这是一个很好的例子是
words.uk: ə ɡreɪt ɪɡˈzɑːmpl əv ðɪs ɪz
words.us: ə ɡreɪt ɪɡˈzæmpl əv ðɪs ɪz
words.ex: A great example of this is when he solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 一个很好的例子是他很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Presenting a particularly effective or illustrative instance of the concept.

words.ex: A personal example is when I failed my math test and tried again.
words.ex_cn: 一个个人例子是我数学考试没及格，然后又试了一次。
words.en: Sharing a personal experience or story that demonstrates the point.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: He didn't study, consequently he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，因此考试不及格。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.tr: phrase. 由于这个原因；因此
words.ex: He was late because of this.
words.ex_cn: 他因为这个原因迟到了。
words.en: As a result of this.

words.ex: He worked hard, leading to better grades.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，导致成绩提高了。
words.en: Leading to is used to indicate that one thing is a result of another or that one thing causes another.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: Generally speaking, most students like math.
words.ex_cn: 一般来说，大多数学生喜欢数学。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or as a general rule.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；总的来说；笼统地说
words.ex: Broadly speaking, the project was a success.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这个项目是成功的。
words.en: You use broadly speaking to indicate that you are talking in a general way about a topic, and that what you are saying may not apply to every single case.

words.ex: In most cases, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 在大多数情况下，他步行去学校。
words.en: In the majority of instances or situations.

words.ex: It's often said that practice makes perfect.
words.ex_cn: 常有人说，熟能生巧。
words.en: A common expression used to introduce a general belief or observation.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 除此之外；更糟的是；而且
words.ex: He lost his job, and on top of that, he broke his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，而且他还摔断了腿。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.w: one more thing about this is
words.tr: 另外还有关于这一点的是
words.uk: wʌn mɔː θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ɪz
words.us: wʌn mɔːr θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ɪz
words.ex: One more thing about this is, the weather is getting colder.
words.ex_cn: 另外还有关于这一点的是，天气正在变冷。
words.en: An additional point or consideration related to the current topic.

words.ex: He not only plays the piano, but also composes music.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅弹钢琴，而且作曲。
words.en: Used to connect two related ideas, emphasizing both equally.

words.ex: Firstly, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: You use firstly in speech or writing when you want to give a reason, make a point, or mention an item that will be followed by others connected with it.

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.ex: To start with, we need some water.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要一些水。
words.en: You use 'to start with' when you are mentioning the first or most basic thing in a series of things, or when you are giving the first or most basic reason for something.

words.ex: To begin with, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: As a first point or reason; initially.

words.ex: First, we need to eat; secondly, we need to study.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要吃饭；其次，我们需要学习。
words.en: You use secondly in speech or writing when you want to make a second point or give a second reason for something.

words.ex: Thirdly, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 第三，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: You use thirdly when you want to make a third point or give a third reason for something.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.ex: Lastly, don't forget to lock the door.
words.ex_cn: 最后，别忘了锁门。
words.en: You use lastly when you are saying what happens after everything else in a series of actions or events.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: He left the party, and subsequently went home.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，随后回家了。
words.en: If something happens subsequently, it happens after something else.

words.ex: After this, we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 此后，我们去了公园。
words.en: Subsequently or following this event or time.

words.w: moving on to the next reason
words.uk: ˈmuːvɪŋ ɒn tu ðə nɛkst ˈriːzən
words.us: ˈmuːvɪŋ ɑːn tu ðə nɛkst ˈriːzən
words.ex: He finished the first point and is moving on to the next reason.
words.ex_cn: 他讲完了第一点，正在转向下一个理由。
words.en: Transitioning to the next point in an argument or explanation.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.w: This is due to the fact that
words.tr: 这是因为；由于这个事实，表示原因或解释
words.uk: ðɪs ɪz djuː tuː ðə fækt ðæt
words.us: ðɪs ɪz duː tuː ðə fækt ðæt
words.ex: He was late this is due to the fact that the bus was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，这是因为公交车延误了。
words.en: A formal way to explain the cause or reason for something.

words.w: The reason why I was that
words.tr: 那就是我之所以那样的原因
words.uk: ðə ˈriːzən waɪ aɪ wɒz ðæt
words.us: ðə ˈriːzən waɪ aɪ wʌz ðæt
words.ex: The reason why I was late is that my bus broke down.
words.ex_cn: 那就是我之所以迟到的原因，因为我的公交车抛锚了。
words.en: The cause or explanation for my previous behavior or state.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.tr: phrase. 接下来；继续进行；转向（下一个话题或阶段）
words.ex: After finishing the first chapter, we are moving on to the next topic.
words.ex_cn: 完成第一章后，我们继续前进到下一个主题。
words.en: To proceed or transition to the next thing or topic.

words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.ex: When it comes to math, he always feels nervous.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他总是感到紧张。
words.en: You use 'when it comes to' to introduce a subject or activity that you are about to discuss or deal with.

words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

words.ex: That's a tough question.
words.ex_cn: 那是个难题。
words.en: A question that is difficult to answer or requires careful thought.

words.tr: phrase. 我没有（用于否定现在完成时）
words.ex: I haven't finished my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我还没完成我的作业。
words.en: Contraction of 'I have not', used to form the negative present perfect tense.

words.ex: I thought about it before I accepted the job.
words.ex_cn: 我在接受这份工作之前考虑过它。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something at an earlier time.

words.ex: This is a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个难题。
words.en: A statement indicating that a question is challenging to answer.

words.w: I'm not quite sure what to say.
words.uk: aɪm nɒt kwaɪt ʃʊə wɒt tuː seɪ
words.us: aɪm nɑːt kwaɪt ʃʊr wʌt tuː seɪ
words.ex: I'm not quite sure what to say when he asks me that question.
words.ex_cn: 当他问我那个问题时，我不太确定该说什么。
words.en: I am uncertain about what to say in this situation.

words.tr: 短语. 我猜；我想；大概
words.ex: I guess we'll have to leave early tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: phr. 我想我们明天得早点出发。
words.en: used to say that you think something is true or likely, although you are not sure

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.w: OK, let me think about that
words.uk: əʊ keɪ, let mi θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðæt
words.us: oʊ keɪ, lɛt mi θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðæt
words.ex: Ok, let me think about that.
words.ex_cn: 好吧，让我想想那件事。
words.en: A phrase used to request a moment to consider a question or topic.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: 短语. 你知道；你明白（常用于口语中，表示对方应理解或认同）
words.ex: You know, I like math.
words.ex_cn: 你知道吗，我喜欢数学。
words.en: Used to indicate that you are thinking about what to say next, or to emphasize what you have just said.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: Without a doubt, he is the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 毫无疑问，他是班上最好的学生。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is definitely true or correct

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: You worked hard and passed the exam. That's definitely true.
words.ex_cn: 你努力学习并通过了考试，那确实是真的。
words.en: An expression of complete agreement with a statement.

words.ex: I strongly agree with it.
words.ex_cn: 我强烈同意这一点。
words.en: A strong statement of agreement with an idea or opinion.

words.ex: I think we should start early, and that's exactly my view.
words.ex_cn: 我认为我们应该早点开始，这就是我的观点。
words.en: A phrase indicating that an opinion matches one's own exactly.

words.tr: phrase. 恐怕不行；恐怕不是这样
words.ex: Can you come to the meeting tomorrow? I'm afraid not.
words.ex_cn: 你明天能来开会吗？恐怕不行。
words.en: Used to politely say that something is not possible or that you cannot do something.

words.tr: phrase. 是；存在；成为（动词 be 的不定式形式）
words.ex: He is to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他将成为一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate existence, identity, or a state or condition.

words.ex: I do not like spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辛辣的食物。
words.en: A direct and firm expression of disagreement or refusal.

words.ex: I'm not tired.
words.ex_cn: 我不是累。
words.en: A phrase used to express disagreement, denial, or refusal.

words.w: I have to say my answer is no to this question
words.tr: 我必须说，我对这个问题的回答是否定的
words.ex: I have to say my answer is no to this question.
words.ex_cn: 我必须说，我对这个问题的答案是否定的。
words.en: A formal way to state a negative answer to a question.

words.tr: phrase. 坦率地说；毫不客气地说
words.en: A phrase introducing a very honest, possibly harsh, opinion.

words.ex: I don't like spinach.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢菠菜。
words.en: A phrase used to express disagreement or refusal.

words.ex: I am not in the slightest worried about the test.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也没有为考试担心。
words.en: Not at all; not even a little.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不； 不必客气
words.ex: I don't like spicy food, not at all.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，一点也不。
words.en: Used as a polite response to thanks or to express that something is not a problem or does not matter.

words.ex: Will you come to the party? That depends.
words.ex_cn: 你会来参加派对吗？那要看情况。
words.en: A phrase used to say that the answer or outcome is not fixed and will vary based on circumstances.

words.tr: 我认为这真的取决于情况
words.ex: I think it really depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这真的取决于天气。
words.en: An expression indicating that a situation is not fixed and may vary.

words.w: That depends on how people look at it
words.tr: 那取决于人们如何看待它
words.uk: ðæt dɪˈpɛndz ɒn haʊ ˈpiːpl luːk æt ɪt
words.us: ðæt dɪˈpɛndz ɑːn haʊ ˈpiːpl luːk æt ɪt
words.ex: Is it good or bad? That depends on how people look at it.
words.ex_cn: 它是好是坏？那取决于人们如何看待它。
words.en: A phrase stating that an answer depends on perspective or circumstances.
